title: BioIVT SMOKTYP uses a shared canonical list (deduplication only, no CDASH standard)
description: Points SMOKTYP across BioIVT studies at the shared canon_smok_type list. No CDASH standard exists for this field; both studies already had identical values under different list names (smok_typ in Precision, smok in Detroit). Pure deduplication, no value changes.
rationale: BioIVT canonical-code-list-library project. No CDASH question here since there is no CDASH codelist and the two studies do not disagree -- just two names for the same list.
source: BioIVT_DataMastering_FeasibilityReport.docx Option C recommendation; canonical-code-list-library plan step 1c

history.note: No CDASH standard exists for this field; deduplication-only convention.
